summary.text: Allison Tant represents Florida House District 9; Tant was elected to the Florida House in 2020 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biography, Tant is a nonprofit founder who lives in Tallahassee and was born in Jacksonville; Tant serves as Minority Deputy Whip for 2024-2026.
Tant holds bachelor's degrees in communications and psychology from Florida State University (1993) and earlier worked as a legislative assistant to two Florida House members in 1985-1988.
